CATTIP.wedding-album-12x36: Plan this 12x36 sheet around one hero photo and two to four supporting frames. Keep faces and names at least half an inch from the centre fold and the trim edge, and export a flattened sRGB JPG at full size for the lab.
CATTIP.album-background: Place this background at the bottom of your layer stack, add your own frames and photos above it, and use a Hue/Saturation or Color Balance adjustment layer to match the rest of the album.
CATTIP.album-cover: Use your strongest couple portrait in the main frame, keep names and date large and simple, and check whether your lab needs a front-only file or a full wrap-around cover with spine.
CATTIP.album-12x30: This file is built at 12x30 proportions, so you do not need to crop a 12x36 layout. Keep faces clear of the centre fold and confirm bleed with your lab.
CATTIP.album-18x24: Large-format pages show every flaw, so use your sharpest, full-resolution photos and proof at 100% zoom before export.
CATTIP.birthday-baby-album: Edit the name and age text first, then clip your photos into the frames. Bright, well-lit photos suit these playful layouts best.
CATTIP.studio-background: Cut out your subject with Select Subject and Select and Mask, place it above this backdrop, and match the lighting with a clipped Curves layer.
CATTIP.wedding-invitation: Edit names, dates and venue text, then export a print file with bleed for the press or a 1080 px JPG for WhatsApp and Instagram.
CATTIP.album-12x18: Use fewer photos and more white space on compact 12x18 pages, and confirm the trim and bleed with your lab.
